Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary proteomics comparison is between cells transfected with SARS-CoV-2 proteins (Nsp1, Nsp2, N) and untransfected controls to identify interacting human proteins. A secondary in vitro comparison was performed for Nsp2 using different cation environments (Zn, Mg, none) to probe structural states.
